verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a proprietary SaaS compliance platform. Whether a software product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The only GitHub evidence is the goSprinto/compliance-skills repo of add-on agent skills. It is not the product's own source, and no license is stated, so there is no evidence that Sprinto's source can be read under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
